name: chesspulse-unified
description: ChessPulse - Full-Stack Modern Chess Intelligence Platform (Unified Monorepo for Render)

scripts.build: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --include=dev --prefix frontend && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "magenta,cyan" "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
